claims.quote: Physiologic α-syn is involved in regulating neurotransmitter release by binding to the SNARE complex protein VAMP-2 on synaptic vesicles.
Short-term exposure to monomers or PFFs for 24 h increased the co-localization of VAMP-2 and syntaxin-1
Long-term exposure to α-syn PFFs for 7 d reduced VAMP-2 and SNAP-25 co-localization
exposure to extracellular vesicles collected from astrocytes treated with α-syn PFFs for 7 d influenced VAMP-2 and SNAP-25 co-localization
